zh.title: 西雪梨國際機場宣布越捷航空將開航胡志明市與曼谷航線
zh.summary: 西雪梨國際機場迎越捷航空進駐；預計2027年開航胡志明市與曼谷
body: 西雪梨國際機場（WSI）宣布，越捷航空（Vietjet Air）將自2027年1月起開航往返越南胡志明市的定期客運航線。這項宣布標誌著該越南航空公司在該機場今年稍後正式啟用旅客營運前，正式進駐雪梨最新的國際航空樞紐 Gateway。
根據西雪梨國際機場發布的資訊，越捷航空於2027年1月起將以每週兩班的頻率營運胡志明市航線，並計劃於2027年3月進一步增加至每週三班。該航線將採用越捷航空配置377個座位的空中巴士（Airbus）A330廣體客機執飛。班機預計於當地時間上午10時抵達西雪梨國際機場，並於中午12時05分起飛返回胡志明市。
除胡志明市航線外，越捷航空旗下合資公司泰國越捷航空（Vietjet Thailand）亦計劃自2027年11月起開航西雪梨國際機場與泰國曼谷之間的航線，預計提供每週四班服務，目前該航線仍有待監管機構批准。胡志明市航線單程票價自299澳幣（約212美元）起，機票預售已於2026年8月10日展開。
胡志明市航線獲得新南威爾斯州政府透過「西雪梨國際機場起飛基金」（Western Sydney International Take-Off Fund）給予資金支持。澳洲聯邦基礎建設部長 Catherine King 表示，該航線為越捷航空在澳洲的第五個航點，目前機場航站樓的測試與最終準備工作正在積極進行中。
越捷航空執行長 Nguyen Thanh Son 表示，航空公司很高興成為首批進駐西雪梨國際機場的航司之一。西雪梨國際機場執行長 Simon Hickey 指出，西雪梨地區擁有超過7萬名越南裔居民，新航線將為當地社區提供直飛胡志明市及轉機至其他目的地的便利服務。

en.title: Western Sydney Airport Announces Vietjet Flights to Ho Chi Minh City and Bangkok
en.summary: Vietjet will launch services from Western Sydney to Ho Chi Minh City and Bangkok starting in 2027.
body: Western Sydney International Airport (WSI) has announced that Vietjet Air will begin operating passenger flights to Ho Chi Minh City starting in January 2027. The announcement marks the Vietnamese low-cost carrier's official entry into Sydney's newest international airport gateway ahead of its scheduled passenger opening later this year.

According to WSI, Vietjet will operate two weekly services to Ho Chi Minh City beginning in January 2027, before increasing frequency to three weekly flights by March 2027. The service will be operated using Vietjet's Airbus A330 aircraft, which seat 377 passengers. Scheduled flights will arrive at WSI at 10:00 local time and depart for Ho Chi Minh City at 12:05 local time.

Additionally, Vietjet's joint venture airline, Vietjet Thailand, plans to launch four weekly services between WSI and Bangkok starting in November 2027, subject to regulatory approval. One-way fares for the January Ho Chi Minh City flights start at AU$299 (US$212), with tickets officially going on sale on August 10, 2026, ahead of Lunar New Year travel in early February.

The new Ho Chi Minh City flights receive support from the New South Wales state government via the Western Sydney International Take-Off Fund, an initiative created to attract airlines and strengthen the state's international route network. Federal Minister for Infrastructure Catherine King stated that the route represents Vietjet's fifth Australian destination as testing and terminal preparations continue at WSI.

Vietjet CEO Nguyen Thanh Son noted that the airline is pleased to become one of the first operators at WSI as it expands its international network. WSI Chief Executive Officer Simon Hickey highlighted that Western Sydney is home to more than 70,000 Vietnamese residents, who will gain direct connections to Ho Chi Minh City and onward destinations.

zh.title: 華航7月營收創歷史新高 長榮航寫單月歷史次高
zh.summary: 華航7月合併營收創單月新高；長榮航寫歷史次高；客貨運動能持續增長
body: 台灣主要航空業者公布2026年7月營收數據，受惠於暑期旅遊旺季旅運需求熱絡與貨運市場穩健成長，中華航空與長榮航空均創下亮眼業績。中華航空7月合併營收與客運營收雙雙刷新單月歷史新高紀錄；長榮航空7月合併營收亦寫下歷史單月次高，顯示國籍航空整體營運動能維持高檔。
中華航空7月單月合併營收達新台幣222.35億元，較去年同期成長25.34%。其中客運收入為126.35億元，年增18.63%；貨運收入達75.89億元，年增34.72%。華航表示，暑假期間東京、大阪、福岡、首爾及釜山等東北亞航點最受旅客歡迎，展望接下來的中秋連假，各航線預估訂位率均可達8成以上。貨運方面，受惠於人工智慧（AI）伺服器、半導體高科技貨源及生鮮水果出貨，包機與包艙需求湧躍。

在累計業績方面，華航今年上半年合併營收創歷史新高，歸屬母公司淨利為65.82億元，每股盈餘（EPS）達1.08元，淨利與每股盈餘均寫下歷年同期次高成績。華航說明，上半年雖然受到中東局勢影響國際油價而增加營運成本，但農曆春節與連續假期帶動客運需求，加上全球AI基礎設施建置推升貨運運量與運價，上半年貨運收入達401.79億元，年增24.89%。下半年將持續交付A321neo、A350-900及787等新機以擴充運能。
長榮航空7月表現同樣強勁，單月合併營收達224.54億元，年增21.42%，創單月合併營收歷史次高。其中7月客運營收為140.65億元，年增17.52%，刷新歷年同期新高；貨運營收則為60.34億元，年增32.76%。長榮航累計前7月客運營收達951.60億元，累計合併營收達1507.39億元，雙雙刷新歷年同期最高紀錄。
長榮航指出，暑期歐美長程航線受到旅遊與返鄉需求帶動，平均載客率達8成5；東北亞及東南亞航線載客率亦接近或達到9成，其中峇里島、清邁、峴港與吉隆坡等熱門航點載客率均超過9成5。此外，長榮航規劃自12月1日起開闢桃園至印度德里直飛航線，提供每週5班服務，以拓展南亞市場並串聯北美航網。貨運部分，雖然歐洲線受新關稅影響跨境電商貨量，但AI供應鏈設備與伺服器貨物需求持續支撐美洲及亞洲區間航班載運量。

en.title: China Airlines Hits Record High Revenue in July as EVA Air Posts Second-Highest Monthly Total
en.summary: China Airlines recorded record high July revenue; EVA Air posted its second-highest monthly consolidated revenue.
body: Major Taiwanese air carriers reported strong revenue performance for July 2026, driven by peak summer travel demand and steady cargo growth. China Airlines posted record-high single-month consolidated and passenger revenues, while EVA Air recorded its second-highest monthly consolidated revenue on record, reflecting robust momentum across both passenger and cargo segments.

China Airlines generated consolidated revenue of NT$22.235 billion in July, representing a 25.34% year-on-year increase. Passenger revenue reached NT$12.635 billion, up 18.63%, while cargo revenue rose 34.72% to NT$7.589 billion. The carrier noted strong travel demand on regional routes to Tokyo, Osaka, Fukuoka, Seoul, and Busan during the summer holidays, with booking rates expected to exceed 80% for the upcoming Mid-Autumn Festival period. Cargo demand was bolstered by shipments of AI servers, semiconductors, and seasonal fresh produce.

For the first half of the year, China Airlines reported record consolidated revenue, with net profit attributable to the parent company reaching NT$6.582 billion and earnings per share (EPS) standing at NT$1.08, both marking the second-highest level for the same period. Despite operational cost pressure from international oil prices influenced by tensions in the Middle East, passenger volume remained strong during holiday periods. Cargo revenue for the first half rose 24.89% year-on-year to NT$40.179 billion, supported by global AI infrastructure expansion. Looking to the second half, China Airlines plans to expand fleet capacity through deliveries of new Airbus A321neo, A350-900, and Boeing 787 aircraft.

EVA Air registered monthly consolidated revenue of NT$22.454 billion in July, an increase of 21.42% year-on-year, marking its second-highest monthly consolidated total on record. July passenger revenue climbed 17.52% to a record high for the period at NT$14.065 billion, while cargo revenue reached NT$6.034 billion, up 32.76%. Over the first seven months of 2026, cumulative passenger revenue reached NT$95.160 billion and consolidated revenue reached NT$150.739 billion, both setting new records for the period.

EVA Air reported average load factors of 85% on long-haul European and North American routes during July, supported by summer travel and family visits. Short-haul North Asian and Southeast Asian routes maintained average load factors near or at 90%, with popular destinations such as Bali, Chiang Mai, Da Nang, and Kuala Lumpur exceeding 95%. EVA Air also announced it will launch a direct route between Taoyuan and Delhi on December 1, operating five flights per week to expand its South Asian footprint and connect with its North American network. On the cargo front, demand for AI equipment and servers supported steady load factors on Americas and Asia routes, offsetting softer European demand impacted by new EU tariff policies.

zh.title: 註冊號 HS-EAD 之 A321neo 抵達桃園機場（TPE）
zh.summary: Airbus A321neo（HS-EAD）抵達臺灣桃園國際機場；呼號 AIQ231；營運者未識別
body: 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，一架註冊號為 HS-EAD 的 Airbus A321neo 航空器於臺灣桃園國際機場（ICAO 代碼 RCTP）完成抵達。本站監測系統觀測到該航空器的首次有效觀測時間為 2026-08-10T09:52:05Z，確認抵達時間為 2026-08-10T10:51:46Z，抵達判定為 confirmed_arrival。確認依據為位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground，有效觀測筆數為 2 筆。
該航空器的 ICAO hex 碼為 881424，ICAO 機型代碼為 A21N，機型顯示名稱為 Airbus A321neo。觀測資料中記錄的呼號為 AIQ231，營運者 ICAO 為 AIQ，但營運者 IATA、營運者名稱、營運者中文名稱及營運者所屬國家或地區均標示為未識別。
本次觀測的主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live，第二資料來源為 ADNB.lol，交叉確認狀態為 secondary_unavailable。事件 ID 為 fw-ffd2338f040252e2，資料類型為公開 ADS-B 觀測。
統計說明指出，系統觀測歷史累積中，尚無可比較的長期統計。本站系統目前無法提供與此航空器及機場組合相關的長期觀測比較數據。
由於營運者相關欄位均為未識別，本報告僅以航空器型號與註冊號指稱該航空器，不對呼號 AIQ231 所對應的航空公司身分進行推測。公開 ADS-B 觴測資料本身未包含航班的起飛地、目的地、飛航目的或載客狀態等資訊。

en.title: Airbus A321neo registered HS-EAD arrives at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE)
en.summary: Airbus A321neo (HS-EAD) arrives at RCTP; callsign AIQ231; operator unidentified
body: Public ADS-B observation data shows that an Airbus A321neo aircraft with registration HS-EAD completed an arrival at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (ICAO code RCTP). The site's monitoring system recorded the first valid observation at 2026-08-10T09:52:05Z and the confirmed arrival time at 2026-08-10T10:51:46Z, with the arrival determination classified as confirmed_arrival.

The confirmation basis was that the aircraft was located within the airport geofence and alt_baro indicated ground level. The number of valid observation records was 2. The aircraft's ICAO hex code is 881424, its ICAO aircraft type code is A21N, and its display model name is Airbus A321neo.

The observation recorded the callsign as AIQ231 and the operator ICAO as AIQ. However, the operator IATA code, operator name, operator Chinese name, and the country or region of the operator are all listed as unidentified in the source data. No airline identity can be confirmed from the available observation fields.

The primary data source for this observation is Airplanes.live, with ADSB.lol listed as the secondary data source. The cross-confirmation status is secondary_unavailable. The event ID is fw-ffd2338f040252e2, and the data type is public ADS-B observation.

The statistical note indicates that the system's observation history is still accumulating and there are no comparable long-term statistics available. The site's monitoring system cannot yet provide historical comparison data for this particular aircraft-and-airport combination.

Because all operator-related fields are unidentified, this report refers to the aircraft solely by its model and registration number and does not speculate on the airline identity corresponding to callsign AIQ231. The public ADS-B observation data itself does not contain information regarding the flight's origin, destination, purpose, or passenger status.
